name: workflowForge
line: paste a workflow, get a page you can send
question: What if any workflow could become a diagram you can send — one where no two lines ever cross?
body: Paste a workflow, get a page you can send. Whatever model you already use writes the JSON; one self-contained HTML file draws it as a DRAKON-style diagram — happy path down the left, exceptions fanning right, severity by shape, and no two lines ever cross. Every step carries a verified, disputed, or unverified state only a human can advance, and the page never reads your process.
